title: feat(marketplace): "update available" badge + Update CTA on package detail
body:
Pairs with cloud #364 (version-targeted install + `check_app_updates`). When the current env has an **older** version of a package installed than the latest published, the marketplace package-detail header now shows an amber **"Update available → vX"** badge and the primary CTA becomes **"Update to vX"** (enabled).

Pure UI — uses data already on the page (`cloudInstalledVersion` vs `latestVersion`); no new endpoints.

## Surface note
Installed-version detection uses `getRuntimeConfig().defaultEnvironmentId`, which is set in a **tenant-env console** (where the badge fires) but empty in the cloud-control console (no single current env) — same existing limitation as the "Installed vX" badge right next to it. Code compiles, app-shell tsc passes, console builds (chunk emitted).
